rationale: This is the archived "Organic R&D Liability Coverage" expression with RANK mechanically swapped for IND_RANK on both legs — a cosmetic neutralization variant rather than a substantively different mechanism, and the archive already documents its portfolio-strong/FMB-weak profile.

The intangible leg is essentially identical to the archived "Uncollateralized R&D Rollover Load" (MA(xrd/at,3) rank minus recognized-intangible rank) and the financing leg is a near-collinear restatement of dlc scaling, so this mostly relabels an already-tested signal's realized positive alpha as the new expected sign while adding one volatility term.

The triple product of unit-interval ranks is internally consistent with the negative expected sign and the added gross-margin-deterioration leg is a genuine third ingredient that diagnoses why the prior levered-goodwill signals flipped positive, though it sits in a heavily mined liability-growth × goodwill region and risks thin, unstable extreme buckets.

This is a straight recombination of two already-tested legs (maturity-shift from "Rollover Goodwill High-Watermark" and the xad/sale-growth-minus-sales-growth payback gap from "Debt-Funded Brand Payback Shortfall"), and the payback leg double-counts sales growth since it already sits in the advertising-intensity denominator.

The construction is internally coherent (deleveraging weight times an own-history-R&D-minus-sales-growth gap, high values plausibly negative) and it is a legitimate diagnosis of the failed "Own-History Organic Funding Pivot," but it shares all three ingredients with the archived "Self-Financing R&D Commercialization," so much of the result is predictable from prior evidence.

Dividing both intangible components by the same liability base leaves a signal that is dominated by intangible composition (identifiable intangibles versus goodwill), making it close to a standalone, well-known goodwill/intangible-intensity sort rather than a genuine financing × intangible interaction.
